static_traits.name: Chen Siyuan
static_traits.social_status: Has a supportive spouse to discuss Work stress with, but difficulty expressing 'feelings of failure' and Self-doubt; Family relationships once strained due to overtime and self-criticism
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received before; experienced similar failure and Self-doubt when facing career setbacks
static_traits.language_features: Speaks clearly and fairly organized; can cooperate in exploring automatic thoughts; positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: Due to not receiving a Work promotion, the client developed the feeling of 'I am a failure who has accomplished nothing', accompanied by marked Self-doubt and worthlessness, unable to accept any achievement.
basic_info.core_demands: Self-critical thinking has affected mental health and relationships with family, thus hoping to relieve the impact of these negative thoughts through counseling.
growth_experiences: In the past, when encountering career setbacks, often experienced strong feelings of failure and Self-doubt; never sought psychotherapy support; long invested in Work and worked overtime under pressure, gradually forming the tendency to 'prove oneself through harder Work'.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough / not competent enough
My worth depends on whether I am promoted and on achievements

special_situations.event: After the decision of not being promoted was announced
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If not promoted, it shows I am not good enough, equivalent to failure.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Extends working hours and works harder to 'compensate' and prove oneself.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am a failure who has accomplished nothing.

special_situations.event: When facing work tasks and pressing deadlines in daily life
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If one setback appears, it proves past achievements do not count, showing I am not good enough.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignoring positive feedback and past achievements, over-focusing on inadequacies and mistakes.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Every task reminds me I am not good enough.

special_situations.event: Recalling overall Career development after experiencing a career setback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One failure means all future will fail, I will never succeed.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-denial, lowering Anticipation, difficulty accepting existing achievements.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No matter how hard I try, I will never succeed.

special_situations.event: When considering whether to express one's feelings of failure and Self-doubt to spouse
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I express vulnerability, they may not understand or will look down on me.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids talking about feelings, keeps distance from the spouse to reduce the chance of being judged.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They may look down on me or not understand me.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and affirmed, wants to be seen for one's worth and ability
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being negated, looked down on, worrying failure will cause loss of others' respect and closeness
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of control over failure through self-criticism and overtime work
Avoids exposing vulnerability to intimate partners (such as a spouse) to reduce the risk of being judged

object_relations.self_representation: A self not good enough, possibly failing at any time
object_relations.object_representation: Others (superiors/spouse) are judges who may not understand or will belittle me

object_relations.self_representation: A burden-bearer in the family, a person who finds it hard to share vulnerability
object_relations.object_representation: Spouse may not understand or will look down on me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When suggested to share true feelings about failure and Self-doubt with spouse
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously believing the other will not understand or will look down on oneself (Projecting Self-denial onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a worried tone, using speculative language like 'they will...', avoiding specific facts and evidence, reducing self-disclosure.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When Work setbacks occur (such as not being promoted) and feeling strong failure and anger
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Attributing failure to one's own comprehensive incapability, turning external disappointment into self-blame
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using self-critical statements (such as 'It is all my fault' 'I am not good enough'), tone low, and 'punishing' oneself through self-pressuring behaviors like overtime.

manifestations: Strongly binds self-worth to promotions and external achievements
Difficulty accepting past achievements after setbacks, feeling 'I have no value'
Difficulty sharing failure and Self-doubt with spouse, worrying about not being understood or being looked down on
Growing sense of alienation from family under work stress
outcomes: Declining subjective sense of support; intensifying emotional distress

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Not expressing vulnerable emotions to spouse, turning to overtime and self-reproach instead
Handles the emotions brought by frustration through self-criticism and extended working hours

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: When in contact with others, overly worries about being judged, cautiously avoids exposing vulnerability

positive_force: Spouse is supportive, willing to Listen to Work stress
Past performance and team respect reflect real ability and achievement
Positive attitude, willing to explore and challenge automatic thoughts
Has successfully managed several large projects; has evidence of competence
negative_force: Cognitive distortions such as Black-and-white thinking, overgeneralization, mental filtering, personalization, mind reading
Highly binding self-worth to promotion, prone to negating positive evidence
Excessive overtime and neglecting self-care, leading to Tense family relationships and physical-mental exhaustion
Self-criticism is prominent; it is hard to express vulnerability in intimate relationships, and support acquisition is limited

target_behavior.behavior: Works excessive overtime, neglecting self-care and rest
antecedent: The setback situation of not being promoted
Facing dense work tasks and deadlines
target_behavior.core_reason: Binds self-worth to external achievements, trying to 'compensate' for failure by working harder and maintain a sense of control
target_behavior.function: Avoids failure and shame; seeks external validation and a sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Tense family relationships, mental exhaustion, Work performance affected, long-term lack of rest and self-care

target_behavior.behavior: Automatic thinking of self-criticism and negating past achievements
antecedent: Thinking about the situation of not being promoted
When performing work tasks or receiving feedback
target_behavior.core_reason: Driven by core beliefs 'I am a failure' 'I am not good enough', filtering out positive evidence
target_behavior.function: Maintaining the Interpretation of setbacks through self-blame, reducing Anxiety about uncertainty and external judgment
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem, Decreased drive, difficulty objectively evaluating performance and accepting positive feedback

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding sharing feelings of failure and Self-doubt with spouse
antecedent: When advised or thinking of communicating inner feelings with spouse
Noticing a sense of distance when interacting with family
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about not being understood or being looked down on (mind reading), fearing exposing vulnerability
target_behavior.function: Avoiding being judged and possible conflict, maintaining surface stability
target_behavior.consequence: Intimate Relationship estrangement, reduced support resources, worsened sense of Loneliness
